newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA FARMA Q1 PROFIT RISES.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA FARMA Q1 PROFIT RISES.

text.p: Estonian drugs maker Tallinna Farmaatsiatehase said on Friday that its first quarter net profit was 11.19 million kroons versus a 7.4 million kroon profit in the same period of 1996.
The company also said in a statement that its total income from operations in first three months of the year was 58.95 million kroons versus 41.60 million kroons.
Its total operational expenses were 42.56 million kroons versus 31.09 million kroons.
The company had an operating profit of 16.39 million kroons versus 10.51 million kroons.
Pr-tax profit was 15.13 million kroons versus 10 million kroons, it added.
The company's assets rose in the first quarter of 1997 to 141.01 million kroons versus 85.67 million kroons in the same period of last year.
Own capital rose to 89.99 million kroons from 53.05 million kroons.
